method: ordered source and encoded frame review
directional_movement: upright graceful glide with feet together and modest wing cadence

acting.greeting: small palm gesture, head inclination, brief wink, return to rest
acting.celebration: small upright airborne lift and controlled landing
acting.failed: brief concern, soft exhale and reassuring recovery
acting.waiting: attentive head tilt and small offered palm
acting.thinking: fingertip at chin, gaze and knowing smile
acting.review: downward inspection scan and confirming nod

independent_standard_review: No visible clipping, loose effects, animal-like crouches or excessive energy. Large eyes and simplified shapes read more clearly at native size.

warnings.observation: The quiet inspection gesture is close to idle in a single still; gaze scan and nod across its ordered frames provide the distinction.
warnings.resolution: Accepted as restrained human acting; no new props or exaggerated movement added.

runtime_review_scope: Automated native transparent-window rendering and command/state tests. No live manual desktop interaction was required for this release.
